    The finite-projective Nakayama--Hom pairing for right modules #

    This file develops the concrete comparison

    Hom_B(Y, D Hom_B(P,B)) \simeq D Hom_B(P,Y)

    for a finitely generated projective right module P. It is the duality input for identifying the Nakayama kernel of a minimal presentation with the Auslander--Reiten translate. The proof uses only the finite frame already constructed in RightModuleNakayama.
